supported_facts: GF0011—2022 is the revision of the 2009 first edition
the revision keeps the existing 201 main radicals
the revision adds/adjusts some attached-form radicals
the revision adds some common radical names and information-processing international codes
sources.boundary: The public notice does not expose the complete 2022 table, so it does not support item-level 2022 glyph/attached-form/name/code adjudication.
Provides the exact 201-item baseline index/main_id used by the project; must not be renamed or treated as the 2022 edition.

policy: Because the official 2022 release notice explicitly states that the existing 201 main radicals are retained, the 2009-reviewed main-radical membership and stable project main_id can be carried forward as a P4 continuity conclusion. Exact 2022 glyph rendering, attached forms, names and codes remain pending until the formal 2022 table or equivalent official item-level data are available.
